Maven runs use -pl <module> -am so sibling module sources are rebuilt from the case base inside the reactor (installed SNAPSHOT jars from a different commit would drift); -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false lets non-target modules skip, and every FIX round is accepted only when the log proves at least one test ran.
